claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: IRL-2500 is a potent and selective ETB receptor antagonist with no known cytotoxic activity; at 2.5 uM it is expected to be largely inactive in a 5-day pooled viability screen.

raw.cytotoxic_mechanism: IRL-2500 is a potent and selective ETB receptor antagonist with no known cytotoxic activity; at 2.5 uM it is expected to be largely inactive in a 5-day pooled viability screen.
